metadata.description: Make websites faster, better for SEO and easier to manage with Flipsite, including moving WordPress sites over.

plugins.name: flipsite
plugins.description: Make a slow WordPress site fast, SEO-friendly and easy to edit: /migrate-to-flipsite rebuilds it on Flipsite with every page, language and URL kept, content in a CMS separate from layout, and an optional PageSpeed (Lighthouse) comparison of the original and the result. Also connects the Flipsite MCP server, so Claude can keep editing the site.
